India Rejects OIC Statement on Kashmir, Cites Internal Affairs

India has rejected a statement on Kashmir made by the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), calling it an interference in India's internal affairs. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) responded to the OIC's comments, which were made outside the UN General Assembly (UNGA) platform and in conjunction with Pakistan. An MEA spokesperson stated that the OIC should first advise Pakistan and focus on terrorism, rather than commenting on India's internal matters.
